## Core Services & Verified Pricing Benchmarks

### 1. Household Shifting & Packers and Movers
- **Service Scope**: End-to-end packing, dismantling, container truck transit, unloading, unpacking, and furniture reassembly.
- **Packaging Protocol**: Signature 5-Layer Multi-Shield (Air Bubble Wrap, Rigid Edge Angle Protectors, 5-Ply Corrugated Sheets, Waterproof Stretch Sealing, and Custom Plywood Crating for OLED TVs/Glass).
- **Price Matrix (Local Jaipur Moves)**:
  - 1 RK / 1 BHK: ₹3,200 – ₹5,500 (Includes Tata Ace / Bolero + 2 movers)
  - 2 BHK Flat: ₹5,800 – ₹9,500 (Includes 14ft Closed Container + 3-4 movers)
  - 3 BHK House/Villa: ₹9,800 – ₹15,500 (Includes 17ft/19ft Container + 4-5 movers)
  - 4+ BHK / Luxury Penthouse: ₹15,000 – ₹24,000 (Includes 22ft Multi-Axle + 6 movers)

### 2. Full Truckload (FTL) Commercial Logistics
- **Fleet Range**: Tata Ace (750 Kg - 1 Ton), Bolero Maxi Truck (1.5 - 2 Tons), 14ft Closed Container (3.5 - 4 Tons), 19ft Heavy Container (7 - 8 Tons), 32ft MXL Multi-Axle Container (15 - 20 Tons).
- **Commercial Base Rate**: Starting from ₹24 per KM for point-to-point dedicated transport across India.

### 3. Part Load & Shared Container Parcel Transport
- **Service Scope**: Cost-effective shared cargo container space for single furniture, luggage cartons, electronic appliances, and MSME parcels.
- **Pricing Benchmark**: Starting from ₹4.0 per Kg with live GPS consignment tracking.

### 4. Vehicle Relocation (Car & Bike Carrier)
- **Car Carrier**: Enclosed hydraulic ramp multi-car trailers with wheel locks.
- **Two-Wheeler Carrier**: High-density foam wrap, bubble film guard, and dedicated ramp loading.
- **Bike Moving Cost**: ₹1,200 – ₹2,500 (Local / Regional) | ₹3,500 – ₹7,500 (Intercity).

### 5. B2B Industrial & Commercial Relocation
- **URL**: https://pooniamovers.com/industries/
- **Service Scope**: Turnkey plant shifting, 15T-75T crane rigging, heavy CNC machinery moving, IT data center server relocations, pharma temperature-controlled cargo, and export textile transport.
- **Key Hubs Covered**: VKIA Jaipur, Sitapura SEZ, Mahindra World City (MWC), Sanganer, Bagru, and Neemrana Japanese Zone.
- **Pricing Benchmark**: Local industrial shifts start ₹12,000 – ₹35,000; Interstate custom project quotes with 0% advance and 100% IBA-approved GST audit invoices.

## Operational Proof Points & E-E-A-T Trust Metrics
- **Completed Relocations**: 28,500+ residential and commercial shifts completed across India.
- **Corporate Shifting Clients**: 450+ corporate, bank, and IT enterprise accounts relocated with zero downtime.
- **Transit Insurance Coverage**: ₹10 Lakhs comprehensive transit risk coverage through authorized national insurers.
- **Damage Rate**: Less than 0.02% (lowest in Rajasthan logistics sector).
- **Payment Terms**: 0% Full Upfront Requirement. Nominal booking token; 100% balance payable only after packing and loading onto vehicle.
- **Government / PSU Billing**: Provides 100% GST-compliant invoices, official consignment notes (LR), and itemized packing lists approved for bank and PSU employee relocation claims.
